text_block_list.text:
The academy was abuzz with talk of Narita Brian—specifically, the incredible
feat of securing a slot in the Sprout Memorial before even making her debut.

Held at Tokyo Racecourse, the exhibition race known as the Sprout Memorial
is said to be the very proving ground where many future legends first emerged.

Everyone's eyes sparkled with anticipation, eager to see what
the "Monster" would do on such a stage—until one fateful day.

Summoned by Student Council President Symboli Rudolf,
Biwa Hayahide and I made our way to the student council room—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A substitute runner...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh—What is the meaning of this, President!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...A bolt from the blue. It is as unexpected for us as it is for you,
though I imagine it comes as the greatest shock to you, Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall repeat it as many times as necessary until you process it.
...Narita Brian has developed a fever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And the substitute chosen for the Sprout Memorial—is you.
Biwa Hayahide, are you willing to run?

This was a golden opportunity. Entering the Sprout Memorial alongside top talents
would bring her significantly closer to perfecting her "Formula for Victory."
Thinking this, I was about to urge her to accept, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is impossible.
I am nowhere near qualified... to serve as Brian's replacement.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There is no way I could ever fill her shoes...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide, that is not—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I know better than anyone just how strong she is!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me. I lost my composure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply concerned about Brian's condition.
Would you permit me to go check on my sister first?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
We were insensitive to your feelings; you have my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... truth be told, we have very little time.
I shall await your answer, Biwa Hayahide.

I accompanied Biwa Hayahide to visit Narita Brian.
The medication had apparently taken effect, and she had just drifted off to sleep, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're in pain. I'm always telling you
to take better care of your health, yet you constantly overexert yourself...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Our roles have completely reversed from that time, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...It happened a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A gap in our physical abilities began to show... and eventually, I could no longer catch up to her back.
Panicked, I threw myself into reckless, excessive training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps sensing my distress, young as she was,
Brian invited me to a footrace one day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It would have been wonderful if I could have just run freely and innocently with her,
back when I was still indisputably the "big sister."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No. Desperate to close the gap on her back no matter how hard I ran,
I failed to watch where I was going... crashed into a fence, and ended up hospitalized.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And while I was stuck in that hospital bed,
Brian continued to grow faster and faster, all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That was when my obsession with theory began.
Since my body was incapacitated, my mind was the only thing free to move.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Confined to bed, drowning in notes and books, I spent day after day constructing theoretical models.
Giving it the grandiose title of the "Formula for Victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And yet—and yet, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Not once has "Narita Brian" ever fit neatly within the parameters of my predictions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She consistently defies my logic. She demolishes my equations.
She is an anomaly that exists entirely beyond standard metrics...!!

Biwa Hayahide spoke with palpable anguish.
...No, she had likely been suffering under this weight for a very long time.

A "Monster" who surpassed all calculation, no matter how much thought went into it.
Even so, through all the pain, Biwa Hayahide kept analyzing, kept calculating—
choice_data_list: ...And through that, you forged a weapon uniquely your own.
...And through that, you forged a weapon uniquely your own.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Your theories are an irreplaceable weapon.
Your theories are an irreplaceable weapon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I already told you, none of it has ever worked against Brian.
The victory on the other side of that equals sign remains forever out of reach!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My theories... have yet to prove a single thing—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...You yourself?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In tomorrow's race, I shall run near the front until the final corner.
The leading pack will inevitably bunch up into a dense cluster."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "As we exit the final corner, I shall break out wide from the exterior—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "And take first place by a margin of over ten lengths."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "—Now, let us proceed!!"
I still vividly remember the thrilling jolt of excitement I felt in that moment.

Hearing Biwa Hayahide lay out her theories made my heart race.
I couldn't help but yearn to assist in seeing them through to perfection!

In that moment, I was undeniably captivated
by the "Formula for Victory" presented by the horsegirl known as Biwa Hayahide...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's reach that equals sign and seize victory together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You truly... believe in me?
You believe that I can reach that realm...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...He is not the only one who believes in you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...She is not the only one who believes in you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: President...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pardon my oversight; there was one crucial detail I neglected to mention.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A crucial detail...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Biwa Hayahide, the one who most emphatically recommended you as her substitute was none other than—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian. She told me
that it absolutely had to be you.

Biwa Hayahide gasped in sheer astonishment.
However, the look on her face soon—
Transformed into the steady gaze of someone fueled by sheer resolve.
